name: Short Guts
summary: Sell an ITM call and an ITM put in the same expiry; collects a large credit that is mostly intrinsic, with undefined risk on both sides. A bad idea wearing a clever hat.
max_profit: credit received - (put strike - call strike)*100, i.e. only the extrinsic collected
max_loss: UNDEFINED on both sides, exactly as a short strangle
breakevens: call strike + credit per share; put strike - credit per share

greeks.theta: positive, but only the extrinsic decays

when_to_use: Essentially never. Identical payoff to a short strangle at mirror strikes, but with guaranteed assignment exposure on both legs from day one, a much larger credit that overstates the actual edge, and worse fills.
entry_rules: BLOCKED ON THIS ACCOUNT and MARKED AS A BAD IDEA. Both legs are uncovered short options -- Level 4 authority, which Alpaca does not offer at all.
Both legs are ITM at entry, which means both carry immediate early-assignment risk. There is no version of this that is safe on an account that must never take delivery.
Defined-risk substitute: iron condor, or simply a short strangle if Level 4 ever existed. In practice: do not implement.
management_rules: If it somehow existed: take profit at 50% of the EXTRINSIC collected, close at 21 DTE, stop at 2x extrinsic.
Monitor both legs' extrinsic values every session; either can be exercised the moment extrinsic dies.
exit_rules: Would need to be closed the instant either leg's extrinsic drops below $0.10, which for ITM options happens within days.
Absolute flatten by 15:30 ET on expiry -- though by construction both legs are ITM and one will certainly be assigned if held.
DIVIDEND GUARD: the ITM short call is a prime early-exercise candidate at every ex-dividend date.
assignment_risk: The highest in the family. BOTH legs are in the money at entry. Early assignment is not a tail risk here, it is the base case. Assignment on the call gives short stock; on the put, long stock; both at once gives you a fully offsetting stock position plus two commissions and a dividend obligation.
buying_power: Reg-T naked on both ITM sides -- very large. Not available.
common_mistakes: Being seduced by the headline credit, which is 80%+ intrinsic and not profit; assuming ITM options will not be exercised early.
family: Two-leg verticals and same-expiry two-leg combos (call/put verticals, straddles, strangles, guts, synthetics/risk reversals, ratio verticals and backspreads)
blocked_because: needs Alpaca options level 4; this account is level 3. Alpaca rejects it with 'account not eligible to trade uncovered option contracts'. Raising the level is an Alpaca approval, not a code change.
